10201.source_text: [auto] [limit 1] if your leader is a ≪universe 2≫ card: when this card is played, draw 1 card, send up to 1 {kakunsa, witchy warrior} from your drop to your warp, then choose up to 1 of your opponent's battle cards, and until the end of your opponent's turn, that card can't attack unless your opponent sends 2 cards from their hand to their warp each time.

10204.source_text: [auto] [limit 1] if your leader is a ≪universe 2≫ card: when this card is played, draw 1 card, send up to 1 {rozie, witchy warrior} from your drop to your warp, add up to 1 black ≪maiden squadron≫ card from your drop or warp to your z-energy, then send up to 2 battle cards from your opponent's drop to their owner's warp.
